description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Lakshman Pinthu Jayathilaka Senevirathne as a member of the Eigth Parliament for the Electoral District No. 19 - Badulla
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy caused by a resignation and the subsequent declaration of a new elected member. The content specifically deals with electoral processes, including the notification of a vacancy, the direction to fill it, and the declaration of an election result, all under the authority of the Commissioner of Elections and in accordance with the Parliamentary Elections Act and the Constitution. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate registrations, and election results.
